def test_server_bridge(self):
        c = OpenWrt({
            "openvpn": [{
                "ca": "ca.pem",
                "cert": "cert.pem",
                "dev": "tap0",
                "dev_type": "tap",
                "dh": "dh.pem",
                "disabled": False,
                "key": "key.pem",
                "mode": "server",
                "name": "bridged",
                "proto": "udp",
                "server_bridge": "10.8.0.4 255.255.255.0 10.8.0.128 10.8.0.254",
                "tls_server": True
            }]
        })
        expected = self._tabs("""package openvpn

config openvpn 'bridged'
    option ca 'ca.pem'
    option cert 'cert.pem'
    option dev 'tap0'
    option dev_type 'tap'
    option dh 'dh.pem'
    option enabled '1'
    option key 'key.pem'
    option mode 'server'
    option proto 'udp'
    option server_bridge '10.8.0.4 255.255.255.0 10.8.0.128 10.8.0.254'
    option tls_server '1'
""")
        self.assertEqual(c.render(), expected)
